name: deconstructed-duotone-poster
title_zh: 版式坐标锁死，只留象牙纸和一种墨的双色海报
tagline_zh: 四种版式：3:4 九宫格、3:4 竖向四联、4:3 六宫格、4:3 横向四联，坐标写死、纸边等宽、瓷砖模板共用。象牙纸底加一种你选的墨色。
tagline_en: Four fixed layouts (3:4 nine-square, 3:4 four-panel, 4:3 six-square, 4:3 four-panel) with locked coordinates; ivory paper plus one ink of your choice.
desc_en: Four fixed layouts (3:4 nine-square, 3:4 four-panel, 4:3 six-square, 4:3 four-panel) with locked coordinates; ivory paper plus one ink of your choice.
why_zh: 它不画不描不用照片细节，全靠大幅简化的平面色块，加分开处理的光晕和克制的墨渗——所以像印出来的，不像滤镜。
why_en: No drawing, hatching or photo detail — reduced flat masses with separate halation and restrained ink bleed, so it reads as printed, not filtered.
limit_zh: 只有那四种固定版式，坐标不可改；想要自由构图的别装。墨色只能选一种。底部固定两行英文打字机小字加极简图标，不能去掉。
limit_en: Only those four layouts; one ink; the two-line typewriter footer is fixed.
title_en: Locked-coordinate duotone posters: ivory paper, one ink
